lines.t: Pull the veil, welcome to the crime scene
Second century switch, dirty doctrinal scheme
Another gospel on the screen, wolf in the fleece
Turned the Shepherd’s quiet voice into state-run priests
They took the Sabbath, broke it, sold it for the sun
Called it “holy,” made the seventh day look done
Philosophy in the cup, told the dead they “live”
Painted over resurrection just to sell their grid
Jude said “fight,” but they cuddled up with snakes
Lawless in the robes, smiling over graves they make
Teachers with the scrolls, but their hearts off-key
Trading covenant obedience for empire fees
Paul saw a falling, mystery of lawless air
Man of sin rising while the saints say “who cares?”
Smooth talk, bright lights, but the Roots cut off
Called it freedom while they laughed at the prophets’ cough
They built towers out of theories, stones of pagan thought
Named it “church,” but every brick was bought
Jealous fire in the heart of the One above
Watching His children chase masks instead of love
This that mystery of lawless smoke in your lungs
Doctrines of demons in the hymns that they sung
Ink smells like brimstone, but they brand it “good news”
Turned the Fountain into fire just to keep you in the pews
But the True One walks in with the scars in the light
YahuShua in the storm, torch raised for the fight
Come out of that system, let the dead bury dead
Wake up from the nightmare that they parked in your head
Early pens dripping anti-covenant spin
Called the Sabbath “Jewish,” dressed Sunday as a win
Blended empire pressure with a philosophic twist
Cut the olive roots, wore the branches like a wrist
Councils in the marble halls shouting “no more Jews”
While the vineyard’s rightful branches hang like bad news
Separated from the feasts, holy days erased
Wrote a new religion, left the ancient paths displaced
Edicts from the throne put the Torah in the crosshairs
Banned signs of obedience, filled the flock with fears
To dodge that heat, they ran from the narrow way
Swapped seventh-day rest for the empire’s day
Passover to “Easter,” crowned another god
Decked winter idols in a festival facade
Old sun feasts dressed up like the Child’s birth
But the root’s still pagan under all that earth
And the Father’s heart burns, not from random rage
But jealousy for children trapped in a cage
They painted Him a tyrant, turned mercy into knives
Twisted justice into torment for unending lives
This that mystery of lawless smoke in your lungs
Doctrines of demons in the hymns that they sung
Ink smells like brimstone, but they brand it “good news”
Turned the Fountain into fire just to keep you in the pews
But the True One walks in with the scars in the light
YahuShua in the storm, torch raised for the fight
Come out of that system, let the dead bury dead
Wake up from the nightmare that they parked in your head
If the dead all live on, what the grave really mean?
Why the cross? Why the stone rolled clean?
If nobody truly sleeps, then the price ain’t paid
Then the pit wears the crown and the Lamb gets played
But He went down silent, rose with the keys
Firstborn from the dead, not a metaphor tease
Resurrection or nothing, that’s the line in the sand
Either ashes underfoot or a kingdom in His hand
Philosophers in vestments say the soul can’t fade
Legal minds in the back make torment never fade
Locked in a vision where the Maker loves to fry
As if holiness is watching rebels never die
But the script speaks of endings, second death cut
Of wickedness consumed, not forever shut
Yet tradition chose the system over what was read
Kept the flames eternal, kept the fear in your head
Now stained glass sermons paint a grinning blaze
As if the Father’s glory is an endless maze
They turned jealous love into sadist art
Hung it in the chapel, aimed it at your heart
But a different drum’s pounding out beyond those walls
A jealous King calling, breaking man-made laws
Fire not to torture, but to cleanse and close
While the meek rise singing from the field of bones
This one’s for the hungry still stuck in those rows
Feeling something off underneath the shows
That ache in your chest is a trumpet, not a flaw
Pulling you from idols back to who He really is
This that mystery of lawless smoke in your lungs
Doctrines of demons in the hymns that they sung
But the Wind still moves and the Lion still roars
Tearing down strongholds in the man-made doors
YahuShua at the gate with His eyes like flame
Calling children from the harlot, stripping off the shame
Not another brand, not another slick list
This the Shepherd in the fire, jealous that you’re missed
He’s not hunting you to crush you, He’s breaking through the spin
So you can see the real Him, and finally walk in.
